title: Story premise EDU074: The Fallen Leaf Changes Teams
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (environment/ecology). Hook: When a leaf stops looking like a leaf, is its story over? Takeaway/theme: Decomposition transforms and redistributes organic matter through ecological processes.
description: A park keeper wants to trace a leaf after it falls, but stops the story when it becomes unrecognizable. A reviewed decomposer sequence follows matter through smaller pieces and biological processes without calling it disappearance.
